text:
Gray and damp to start this Sunday, with a few lingering showers that should wrap up by mid to late morning. After that we get a dry afternoon, still mostly cloudy but mild enough, with a high near 51. A light jacket does the job.

Showers return tonight, on and off from around 8, adding up to about a tenth of an inch, with a low near 42. Monday looks like the wetter of the two days. The best chance is the morning commute, roughly 4 to 10, peaking around 7, then it turns more scattered through the afternoon. The high is near 51 again. The models don't agree on how much rain we get, with one fairly dry and two much wetter, so I'd lean wet and keep the umbrella by the door.

Tuesday and Veterans Day look a bit drier, with only a stray shower. The thing to watch is a coastal storm late in the week, which could bring a rain and snow mix Thursday into Friday, possibly the first real snow of the season. One outlook keeps us drier but colder, so the details are still up in the air.

Partly sunny and chillier with a high near 44, a dry day, and a freezing night ahead.
Looks like partly sunny and cold, high near 43, with a slight chance of a rain and snow mix after breakfast.
Mostly cloudy and chilly near 45, with an outside chance of a rain and snow mix if the pattern holds.
